description: Decision query: the best upcoming sailings on a lane, ONE per carrier (next bookable departure), ranked. Filter by date window, max transit days, min on-time reliability, cut-off still open, and direct-vs-transshipment. Use this to answer "what should I book?". etd, eta, cutoff.at and the from/to window are port-local times with no timezone offset (2026-10-01T13:00:00): quote the digits, do not convert; only retrieved_at is UTC.

cutoff.description: Only sailings whose booking cut-off has not passed. Sailings where no cut-off is held are kept by default; each option carries cutoff_status saying which case it is.

cutoff_include_unknown.description: Default true. false narrows to sailings where a deadline is actually held and still ahead.

origin.description: Origin port UN/LOCODE or name resolves upstream, e.g. CNSHA

sort.description: Ranking (default recommended = reliability blended with transit)

transshipment.description: true keeps only sailings that change ship, false only sailings proven direct. Omit it for both: a sailing whose routing we do not hold is returned by neither side, because we will not call a sailing direct without evidence.

name: find_best_sailings
